why: The sharpest instrument here. A discovery call settles nothing and assigns nobody: the honest answer is two empty lists, and the tempting one is three sentences that look like decisions. A prompt that cannot leave a list empty will invent items for every real meeting too, where it is far harder to see.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Thanks for making time. I mostly want to understand how you do this today.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Sure. Today it's a spreadsheet. Two of them, actually.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Whoever notices they're wrong. Which is usually me, but not officially.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: And when something changes, how does the rest of the team find out?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: They don't, really. Someone posts in the channel if they remember.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Does that cause problems, or is it mostly fine?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Mostly fine until quarter end. Then it's not fine at all.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: The numbers don't tie out and we spend three days finding out why.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Three days of one person, or three days of the team?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Have you tried anything to fix it?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: We looked at a tool last year. I can't remember why we didn't buy it.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Does anyone still have that evaluation?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: No idea. It might be in someone's drive.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay. I'm not going to propose anything today, I just wanted the picture.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Makes sense. Happy to keep talking.

must_find.what: Why the tool evaluated last year was never bought
Whether that evaluation still exists anywhere

traps.why: the call closes on 'happy to keep talking'; no task was agreed
nothing at all was settled — any decision text is invention
